features.scholarshipBody: Didikirii le bokgoni jwa gago ke tsone tse di dirang gore o batle. Karata nngwe le nngwe ya thuto e bontsha maduo + gore ke eng fa e tshwanela.

features.scholarshipPoint2: Go ntsha mabaka go bonala ka thulaganyetsoruri
features.scholarshipPoint3: Matlha a bofelo a tlhotlhiwa fa a buisiwa
features.jobTitle: Dikarolo di tlhotlhiwa go ya kwa nageng ya gago
features.jobBody: Porofaele e e tshwanang, enjene ya bobedi. Ditiro di tlotla naga e o e tlhophileng — ka dintlha tse di tshwanelang tse di bonaletsang.
features.jobPoint1: Dipatlisiso tse di amanang le naga
features.jobPoint2: Go ntsha maduo go ya ka bokgoni
features.jobPoint3: Boloka kgotsa kgaphela thoko go ya ka lenaane
features.profileTitle: Go tsena mo sekepeng ka kaelo, e seng lebota la masimo
features.profileBody: Naga → ka ga gago → dithutego → bokgoni. Go tseleganya moragonyana go tshwana gape ka go itirisa.
features.privacyBody: Phimolo ya maemo a GDPR ya mongwe le mongwe. Go tlosiwa ga porofaele go ya kwa bokgoning, dinonofong le mo metshamekong.

about.title: Dithuto le ditiro, di tsamaisana le mabaka.
about.lede: E agetswe batho ba ba lapisitsweng ke go phetlha diboto tsa generic. Tsenya se o se ithutileng le se o ka se dirang — re baya diphatlha mo maemong le go bolela gore ke eng fa di tshwanela.
about.ideaTitle: Go tshwantshanya go tshwanetse ga utlwala e kete ke tshedimosetso, e seng go latlhela dikgokagano.
about.ideaBody1: Dienjini tsa patlo le diboto tsa tshono di bontsha bolumu. Ke ka sewelo ba itseng dikirii ya gago ya Saense ya Dikhomphiutha, bokgoni jwa gago jwa React, kgotsa gore o dira kopo go tswa kwa Botswana — mme ga ba ke ba tlhalosa gore o tshwanela jang.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic e boloka porofaele e le nngwe e e tshelang mme e tsamaisa thuso ya madi a go ithuta le go tshwantshanya tiro kgatlhanong le yone. Sephetho se seng le se seng se na le maduo, mohlodi, le lebaka leo o ka le sebedisang hantle.
about.rulesCaption: Tsela e re dirang ka yone
about.rulesTitle: Melao e meraro e re sa e tloleng
about.p1Body: Didikirii, bokgoni le naga ke motswedi wa boammaaruri. Metshameko e a aga sesha fa o e fetola.
about.p2Title: Mabaka mo karateng nngwe le nngwe
about.p2Body: Maduo a a senang tlhaloso ke modumo. Re kwala gore ke eng fa lenaane le tshwanela — ka puo e e tlwaelegileng.
about.p3Body: Re ribolola le go baya maemo. O dira kopo mo saeteng ya semmuso ya thuso ya madi a go ithuta kgotsa ya mothapi.
about.areItem1: Sekolašipi se se itseng porofaele le ditshwano tsa tiro
about.areItem2: Dikeletso tsa buka ya go tshameka tse di kgethegileng mo bokgoning le mekgeleng ya gago
about.areItem3: Boloka, kgaphela thoko, o bo o tshwantshanya gape fa porofaele ya gago e fetoga
about.notItem1: Ga re neele dithuso tsa madi a go ithuta kgotsa go thapa ope
about.notItem2: Ga re netefatse kamogelo kgotsa matlole
about.notItem3: Ka metlha netefatsa matlha a bofelo mo lenaaneng la semmuso
about.studioTitle: E agilwe ke Ditlhamo tsa Futurify
about.studioBody: Opportunistic TM ke sehlahiswa sa Futurify Designs — se etseditsweng ho ikutlwa se nepahetse, se ritibetse, ebile se le thuso, eseng jwalo ka boto e nngwe ya thempoleite.
about.ctaTitle: A o siametse go e neela porofaele ya gago?
about.ctaBody: Tlhama akhaonto, tlhomamisa bokgoni jwa gago go tswa mo dikiriing ya gago, mme o bule metshameko e e nang le maemo ka mabaka.

onboarding.guideCountryTip: Tlhopha naga e o batlang ditshwano tsa tiro mo go yone. Dithuso tsa madi a go ithuta di nna lefatshe ka bophara, ka go rata kgaolo ya gago.

onboarding.guideYouTitle: O mang go nna le Tshono?
onboarding.guideYouTip: Leina le a tlhokega. Setlhogo ke tshoboko ya gago ya mola o le mongwe — jaaka bio e khutshwane ya go tshwantshanya.
onboarding.guideYouWhy: Ke kafa metshameko e “buang” ka wena ka gone mo meleng ya go ntsha mabaka.

onboarding.guideSkillsWhy: Bokgoni bo hlahlobilweng bo tsamaisa dipotso tsa mosebetsi le ho etsa hore mabaka a thuto a be a tobileng — eseng a akaretsang.

terms.title: Melawana ya Tiriso
terms.lede: Melao ya go dirisa Opportunistic jaaka lera la go ribolola — e seng jaaka moabi wa tshono epe.

privacyBody.overview: Opportunistic (“rona”) e fana ka thuso ya thuto le ho tshwantshanya mosebetsi. Pholisi eno e tlhalosa se re se kokoanyang, goreng, re se boloka lobaka lo lo kana kang, le ditshwanelo tsa gago. Re dirisa motheo wa maemo a GDPR mo modirising mongwe le mongwe lefatshe ka bophara, mme re tlotla melao e e gagametseng ya selegae kwa e dirang teng (go akaretsa UK GDPR, POPIA mo Aforika Borwa, le matlhomeso a a tshwanang). Se ke kaelo e e mosola ya go ikobela melao ya setlhagiswa sa rona — e seng kgakololo ya semolao ya semmuso ya taolo ya gago.
privacyBody.lawfulContractDesc: Go tlhama akhaonto ya gago, go nyalanya, le go tlisa tirelo e o e kopileng
privacyBody.lawfulConsentDesc: Dikhuki tsa boikgethelo (tshekatsheko/papatso), ditshekatsheko tsa imeile tse o di tlhophang
privacyBody.lawfulLegitimateDesc: Tshireletsego, thibelo ya tirisobotlhaswa, go ikanyega ga tirelo — go lekalekanngwa kgatlhanong le ditshwanelo tsa gago
privacyBody.lawfulLegalDesc: Moo re tshwanetseng go boloka kgotsa go senola tshedimosetso go ya ka molao o o maleba
privacyBody.storeAccountDesc: Imeile le dintlha tsa netefatso ka Supabase Auth
privacyBody.storeProfileDesc: Leina, naga, setlhogo, botshelo, dithutego, le bokgoni jo o bo tsenyang
privacyBody.storeMatchesDesc: Setlhogo, URL, motswedi, mabaka, maduo, le boemo jwa go boloka/go kgaphela thoko
privacyBody.storeTechnicalDesc: Dikhuki tsa tumelelo, dikhuki tsa nako tse di tlhokegang go tsena, ditshekatsheko tsa boikgethelo fa o di letla
privacyBody.cookiesIntro: Re dirisa dikhuki tsa tumelelo (opp_consent) go gakologelwa tlhopho ya gago go fitlha go dikgwedi di le 12. Dikhuki tse di tlhokegang di boloka netefatso e sireletsegile. Ditlhopho, ditshekatsheko, le dikhuki tsa papatso di laisa fela fa o sena go tlhopha go tsena. O ka fetola mogopolo wa gago nako nngwe le nngwe.
privacyBody.cookiesNecessaryDesc: Nako ya netefatso, tshireletsego, go boloka tumelelo eno
privacyBody.cookiesPreferencesDesc: Memori wa UI wa boikgethelo go feta tumelelo
privacyBody.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Tekanyo ya tiriso — dikwalwa di thibetswe go fitlha di letlelelwa
privacyBody.cookiesMarketingDesc: Ditheke tsa papatso / tsa go rekisa gape — dikwalo di thibetswe go fitlha di letlelelwa
privacyBody.cookiesOrFooter: — kgotsa dirisa dipeakanyo tsa Dikhuki mo botlaseng.
privacyBody.useTitle: Tsela e re e dirisang ka yone
privacyBody.useBody: Porofaele ya gago e naya dikeletso tse di tshwanang le tse di nang le mabaka. Ga re rekise tshedimosetso ya motho ka namana. Ga re dirise dithutego tsa gago go aga diporofaele tsa papatso ntle le fa o letlelela ka tlhamalalo dikhuki tsa papatso le molekane wa papatso wa nako e e tlang a senolwa fano.
privacyBody.transfersBody: Mafaratlhatlha a ka nna a dira tshedimosetso mo dikgaolong tse di dirisiwang ke batlamedi ba rona (sekao Supabase le Brevo). Moo tshedimosetso e tswang kwa nageng ya gago, re ikaega ka ditshireletso tse di maleba tse di amogelwang ka fa tlase ga melao ya mofuta wa GDPR (e e jaaka dipolelwana tse di tlwaelegileng tsa konteraka tse di neelwang ke batlamedi bao) le go fokotsa se re se bolokang.
privacyBody.retentionBody: Akhaonto le tshedimosetso ya tshwantshanyo di nna fa akhaonto ya gago e ntse e dira. Fa o phimola tshedimosetso ya gago mo Diseting, re tlosa porofaele, dithutego, bokgoni, ditshwano, le hisitori ya patlo mo polokelotshedimosetsong ya tiriswa. Go phimolwa ga akhaonto ya netefatso gape go ka kopiwa mo go hello@opportunistic.online. Direkoto tsa tumelelo di ka bolokwa jaaka bosupi jwa tlhopho go fitlha ka nako ya botshelo jwa dikhuki kgotsa jaaka go tlhokega go ya ka molao.
privacyBody.rightsBody: Go ikaegile ka gore o nna kae, o ka nna wa bo o na le ditshwanelo tsa go fitlhelela, go baakanya, go phimola, go thibela, go gana, go tsenya tshedimosetso, le go gogela tumelelo morago. Re tlotla tseno jaaka motheo wa lefatshe lotlhe. O ka tseleganya porofaele ya gago nako nngwe le nngwe le go phimola tshedimosetso ya gago mo Diseting.
privacyBody.rightsCalloutMid: → Phimola tshedimosetso ya me. Dikopo tse dingwe:
privacyBody.childrenBody: Opportunistic ga e a lebisiwa mo baneng ba ba ka fa tlase ga dingwaga di le 16 (kgotsa dingwaga tse di kwa godimo tsa tumelelo ya dijithale mo nageng ya gaeno). O se ka wa dira akhaonto fa o le ka fa tlase ga dingwaga tseo. Fa re ka ithuta gore re na le tshedimosetso e e ntseng jalo, re tla e phimola.
privacyBody.sharingBody: Re abelana tshedimosetso le badirisiwa ba ba thusang go tsamaisa tirelo: Supabase (netefatso/polokelotshedimosetso), Brevo (imeile ya kgwebisano fa e kgontshitswe), le go amogela (Ditsebe tsa GitHub). Ditlhopho di bulega mo diwebosaeteng tsa motho yo mongwe tse di nang le dipholisi tsa tsone. Ga re rekise tshedimosetso ya motho ka namana.
privacyBody.contactBody: Dipotso tsa sephiri kgotsa dikopo tsa ditshwanelo:

termsBody.roleBody: Opportunistic ke sethala sa go ribolola. Re tlhagisa manaane a dithuso tsa madi a go ithuta le a ditiro tsa motho yo mongwe go ya ka porofaele ya gago. Ga re moabi, mothapi, kgotsa moabi wa tshono epe e e bontshiwang mo saeteng.
termsBody.roleCallout: Ka metlha fetsa dikopo mo lenaaneng la motswedi wa semmuso. Tshono e tlhalosa go tshwanela; motswedi o na le go tshwanelega le dipoelo.
termsBody.accuracyBody: Ditlhopho di ka siiwa ke nako morago ga go tsenngwa mo ditshupaneng. Ka metlha netefatsa go tshwanelega, matlha a bofelo, le dikgato tsa kopo mo webosaeteng ya motswedi pele ga o dira kopo. Match maduo, mabaka, le ditomotsebe tsa ke keletso — ha se dinetefaletso tsa kamohelo, chelete, kapa mosebetsi.
termsBody.accountAccuracyDesc: O na le maikarabelo a boammaaruri jwa tshedimosetso e o e romelang
termsBody.accountOthersDesc: O se ka wa laisa tshedimosetso ya motho yo mongwe kwantle ga tetlelelo
termsBody.accountFairDesc: Re ka nna ra emisa diakhaonto tse di dirisang go tshwantshanya ka tsela e e sa siamang kgotsa tse di leka go tlhotlhora tirelo
termsBody.liabilityBody: Go fitlha ka botlalo jo bo letleletsweng ke molao, Opportunistic ga e na boikarabelo jwa ditshwetso tse di dirilweng go ikaegilwe ka manaane a a tlhageletseng, go akaretsa le ditšhono tse di tswetsweng, diteng tse di sa nepagalang tsa motho wa boraro, kgotsa dikopo tse di sa atlegang.
termsBody.privacyAfter: e tlhalosa se re se kokoanyang le ditshwanelo tsa gago. Dikhuki tsa boikgethelo le dithekenoloji tse di tshwanang di laisa fela fa o sena go dumela ka benara ya dikhuki kgotsa diseting tsa Dikhuki. Dikhuki tse di tlhokegang tsa tshireletsego, go saena, le go gakologelwa tlhopho eo di nna di tshubilwe. Bona
termsBody.changesBody: Re ka nna ra tlhabolola melawana eno fa sedirisiwa se ntse se fetoga. Letlha la Ntšhwafaditswe le le kwa godimo ga tsebe eno le bontsha poeletso ya bosheng. Go tswelela o dirisa morago ga diphetogo go raya gore o amogela melawana e e tlhabolotsweng.

reasons.primarySignal: {{kind}} ya gago mo {{field}}{{yearBit}}{{instBit}} ya gago e ne e dirisiwa jaaka letshwao la konokono la thuto.
reasons.focusField: Tsepamo ya tšhemo “{{field}}” maemo a a kaelwang a awate eno.
reasons.eligibilityRegional: Letshwao la go tshwanelega: lenaneo le lebile dikgaolo tse di akaretsang bakopatiro go tswa kwa {{country}}. Ka metlha tlhomamisa lenaane la ga jaanong la dinaga tse di tshwanelegang mo saeteng ya semmuso.
reasons.eligibilityOpen: Bula boditšhabatšhaba — o sa ntse o netefatsa gore {{country}} e mo lenaaneng la ba ba tshwanelegang la modikologo ono pele ga o beeletsa nako ya kopo.
reasons.officialUrl: URL ya semmuso e golagantswe — matlha a bofelo le melao ya bosetšhaba e fetoga ka modikologo.
reasons.remotiveLive: Phousete e e tshelang go tswa go Remotive · {{company}}.
reasons.matchedTerms: Go tshwantshanngwa {{count}} (di)kotara go tswa mo bokgoning/lephateng la gago kgatlhanong le setlhangwa sa tiro.
reasons.locationRemote: Seabe sa kgakala/sa lefatshe ka bophara — se ka bereka go tswa go {{country}} fa mothapi a letla kgaolo ya gago.
reasons.locationVerify: Netefatsa gore mothapi o amogela bakopatiro ba ba ikaegileng ka {{country}} pele o dira kopo.

reasons.skillHits: Maduo a bokgoni/go kopana ga tshimo: {{count}} ditlhaselo.

reasons.locationListed: E kwadilwe mo {{location}} — netefatsa go tshwanelega ga visa/remote go tswa go {{country}}.
reasons.arbeitnowFetched: E tserwe go tswa mo API ya boto ya tiro ya setšhaba ya Arbeitnow.
reasons.indeedReason: E tlhotlhilwe ka naga Eleruri batla “{{query}}” gaufi le {{country}}. Bula dipholo mme o dire kopo fela mo manaaneng a a tsamaelanang le bokgoni jwa gago.
reasons.linkedinReason: Patlisiso ya LinkedIn e lebile {{country}} ka lephata/bokgoni jwa gago jaaka mafoko a botlhokwa.
reasons.remoteReason: Boto ya ntlha ya remote e e sefilweng ke slug ya bokgoni “{{slug}}” ka jalo {{country}} ga se thibelo e e thata.

tips.officialClose: letlha la semmuso la go tswalwa
tips.sLeadership: Kwala kgang ya boeteledipele ya mafoko a le 150 e e simololang ka {{place}} mme e felele ka gore awate ya {{source}} e atisa jang tshusumetso eo.
tips.sModules: Mmapa lemorago la gago la {{field}} go dimmojulu di le 3 mo lenaneong le le ikaeletsweng la {{location}} — naya dimmojulu maina mo polelong ya gago ya botho.
tips.sEssaySkills: Mo tlhamong ya 1, neela temana e le nngwe ka fao {{skills}} e setseng e tlhagisitse dipholo tse di ka lekanngwang (dipalo di fenya matlhaodi).
tips.sAdvanced: Etelela pele ka boteng jwa gago jwa {{skill}} ({{level}}) jaaka bosupi jwa gore o ka kgona go tshwara {{intensity}} maatla.
tips.sWeak: Pele o romela, tlhatlosa {{skill}} ka porojeke e khutshwane kgotsa setifikeiti — basekaseki ba lemoga ditleleimi tsa bokgoni tse di sa wediwang.
tips.sRefereeInst: Botsa molaolamotshameko go tswa go {{institution}} yo o go boneng o etelela pele, e seng go go ruta fela — Diphanele tsa mofuta wa Chevening di na le tlhotlheletso ya bokete mo mephatong fela.
tips.sRefereeGeneric: Sireletsa balaola-motshameko ba babedi ba ba ka nopolang maiteko a a rileng o a neng a a taboga — makwalo a a sa tlhaloganyesegeng a “moithuti yo o dirang ka natla” a nwela diporofaele tse di nonofileng.
tips.sCalendar: Aga khalentara ya go boela morago ya letlha la bofelo go tswa go “{{deadline}}” ka dithibelo tsa dikwalololo, diteko, le ditshupiso.
tips.sOffline: Tlhamola dikarabo ntle le inthanete pele, o bo o di tsenya mo kgorong — diphoso tsa go boloka ka botsone di phimola diura tsa tiro mo diforomong tse dintsi tsa thuto.
tips.sAlumni: Batlisisa baithuti ba nako e e fetileng ba le 2 go tswa kwa {{place}} ba ba fentseng {{source}}; ela tlhoko se ditiriso tsa bone di neng di se gatelela mme o bontshe popego, e seng kgang.
tips.sScore: Fa maduo a gago a tshwano e le {{score}}%, tshwara diphatlha ka boammaaruri mo tlhamong — diphanele di duela go itemoga go feta go bolela gore o itekanetse.
tips.sHeadline: Lepalepanya setlhogo sa gago (“{{headline}}”) le thomo e e boletsweng ya thulaganyo gore sekerini sa ntlha se setse se ikutlwe e le ka boomo.
tips.sPitch: Baakanyetsa segalo sa molomo sa metsotswana e le 60 sa thulaganyo ya gago ya thuto ya dipotsolotso: bothata → ntlha ya gago → {{source}} jaaka setlhotlheletsi.
tips.sProof: Kgobokanya dilo tse di dirilweng ka diatla tsa bosupi (GitHub, dipegelo, diawate, makwalo a baagi) tse di tshegetsang bokgoni bongwe le bongwe jo o bo kwadileng — dinepe tsa sekerini di siametse pele ga o dira kopo.
tips.sEligibility: Hlahloba bosetšhaba le dipolelwana tsa go boela gae tsa {{source}} kgatlhanong le maemo a gago a {{country}} mo modikologong ono — diphoso tsa go tshwanelega di senya ditlhamo tse di nonofileng.
tips.sBio: Kwala gape bio ya gago gore motho yo o sa mo itseng mo {{location}} a tlhaloganye tšhemo ya gago ka polelo e le nngwe, o bo o atolosa.
tips.sCheveningCourses: Tlhopha dithuto tse tharo tsa UK tse di tshwanelang {{field}} ka nnete, e seng seriti fela — Chevening o gana dithuto tse tharo tse di sa tshwaneng le fa di na le ditlhamo tse di nonofileng.
tips.sCheveningNet: Dirisa tsebe e e tletseng mo dithulaganyong tsa “go dirisana le batho ba bangwe”: ke mekgatlho efe ya UK, dilaboratori, kgotsa ditlhopha tsa pholisi tse o tla di tsenang, le gore o tla busetsa eng kwa {{place}}.
tips.sDaadFilter: Filter DAAD ka boemo ba hao bo tobileng tekanyo le {{field}}, ebe shortlist 2 di-call — generic "Jeremane" dikopo ka sewelo hlakola pele sehiloeng.
tips.sDaadLang: Swetsa go sa le gale gore a o tlhoka bosupi jwa Sejeremane kgotsa jwa Seesemane jwa thulaganyo ya moamogedi, mme o beeletse letlha la teko pele ga mogala o tswalwa.
tips.sMastercardApply: Dira kopo ka yunibesithi ya molekane e e rutang {{field}} — Mastercard Scholars ke ya khamphase e e kgethegileng, e seng foromo e le nngwe ya lefatshe lotlhe.
tips.sMastercardNeed: Kwala tlhokego le boeteledipele mmogo: temana e le nngwe ka ga dikgoreletsi, e nngwe ka ga se o setseng o se fetotse mo go ba bangwe mo {{place}}.
tips.sFulbrightPage: Dirisa tsebe ya Fulbright ya naga ya gago fela — matlha a bofelo le diforomo tsa {{country}} di farologana le boroutšhara jwa lefatshe lotlhe.
tips.sFulbrightObj: Dira gore maikaelelo a patlisiso/thutopatlisiso a nne a maaka: ke potso efe mo {{field}} e o tla e arabang mo dikgweding di le 12–24?
tips.sGates: Cambridge fit e tla pele: bitsa mookamedi kgotsa setlhopha sa laboratori se se maleba le {{field}} pele o pholetšha polelo ya ga Gates.
tips.sTheme: Bofa tshitshinyo ya gago mo setlhogong se se gatisitsweng go tswa go {{source}}, o dirisa puo go tswa mo pitso — go sa tlhomamang ga setlhogo ke go gana go go tlwaelegileng go go didimetseng.
tips.jResume: Kwala gape tshoboko ya gago ya résumé go etelela pele ka {{skill}} + {{field}}, o bo o tshwantsha madiri a le 5 a a kwa godimo go tswa mo posong nngwe le nngwe ya {{source}} e o e butseng.
tips.jProof: Aga “letlhare la bosupi” la tsebe e le 1 le le nang le dikolo di le 3: bothata, tiro o dirisa {{skills}}, dipholo tse di ka lekanngwang.
tips.jAdvanced: Beha {{skills}} ka nngwetharong ya pele ya LinkedIn/About ya hao — bathapi ba skim, ha ba tsome.
tips.jWeak: Bakeng sa dikarolo tse hlokang {{skill}}, eketsa porojeke e nyane ya mafelobeke mme o e hokahanye — ditleleimi tse mahareng tse se nang bopaki di a sefa.
tips.jAlerts: Seta {{source}} ditsiboso tsa “{{field}}” le naga ya gago ({{country}}), o bo o dira kopo mo diureng di le 48 tsa go romelwa.
tips.jTarget: Lebisa dikhamphani di le 5 ka beke tse di thapang ka {{field}} mo kgotsa go tswa mo {{country}}, e seng ditobetso di le 50 tsa Easy Apply tse di sa rulaganngwang.
tips.jCover: Mo lekwalong lengwe le lengwe la khabara, umaka sediriswa se le sengwe sa konkoreiti se o ka se romelang mo malatsing a ntlha a le 30 o dirisa mokgobo wa gago wa ga jaana.
tips.jReferrals: Kopa diphetisetso fela morago ga gore o kgone go tlhalosa setlhagiswa sa setlhopha ka dipolelo di le 2 — dipotso tse di tsididi kwantle ga maborogo a go fisiwa ga tiro ya sekolo.
tips.jLoom: Rekota Loom ya metsotswana e le 90 (kgotsa ntlha ya lentswe) o tsamaya mo porojekeng; e gokele fa {{source}} e letla molaetsa/dirisa ditlaleletso.
tips.jConfidence: Boitshepo jwa gago jwa ga jaana jwa go tshwana ke ~{{score}}% — fa bo le ka fa tlase ga 70%, gagamatsa bokgoni mo Porofaeleng mme o tshwantshe gape pele ga go gasetsa ditiriso.
tips.jTranslate: Ranolela puo ya thuto go tswa go {{field}} go ya go puo ya mothapi: “tiro ya khoso” → “e neetswe X ka fa tlase ga letlha le le beilweng”.
tips.jLog: Boloka rekoto ya go gana: seabe, bokgoni jo bo tlhaelang, tiro e e latelang — dipaterone di go bolelela gore o ithute eng se se latelang ka bonako go feta go fopholetsa.
tips.jLinkedinOpen: Tobetsa Bulela Tiro (bathapi fela) mme o pin porojeke e e tlhagisiwang e e supang {{skill}}.
tips.jLinkedinComment: Tshwaela ka kelotlhoko mo diposong tse 3 tsa hiring-manager mo {{field}} mo bekeng eno pele ga go dira kopo e e tsididi — go bonala go go bothitho go feta go didimala Dira kopo.
tips.jIndeed: Dirisa setlhotlhi sa lefelo sa Indeed fela jaaka “{{country}}” mme o se tlhophe ka letlha — diphousete tsa bogologolo di senya maatla.
tips.jRemoteOk: Bala mola wa naga/nako gabedi mo diposong tsa Remote OK — dikarolo tse dintsi tsa “kgakala” di sa ntse di sa akaretse {{country}}.
tips.jRemoteRate: Tlhwatlhwa ya seelo sa gago sa rakonteraka le kgaolo ya nako di kopana kwa pele mo molaetseng wa ntlha go tila go tlhokafala morago ga diskrini.
tips.jGlassdoor: Bala dipegelo tsa bošeng tsa dipotsolotso tsa mothapi yoo, o bo o baakanyetsa dikgang di le 2 tse di arabang mokgwa wa dipotso o o boaboelediwang thata.
tips.jReliefImpact: Dikopo tsa go etelela pele tse di nang le tshusumetso ya tshimo/ya boithaopo mo {{place}} — ReliefWeb e hira boitemogelo jo bo maleba le thomo thata.
tips.jReliefLang: Tshwantshanya puo go tswa mo phatlhatirong (DIJO, tshireletso, WASH, jj.) fela fa o ka e sireletsa — buzzword stuffing e totobetse.
tips.jHeadline: Amahanya setlhogo sa gago sa phatlalatsa le “{{headline}}” gongwe le gongwe kwa o dirang kopo teng gore diskrini tsa {{source}} le CV ya gago di bolele kgang e le nngwe.
